summary: Item 'look' is built across two runs. The first run was cut off after its final checks. This run re-applied its patch to the clean worktree, fixed one tip, re-ran what was lost and measured the numbers. (1) Review findings. Fixed already in 0.8.3 (commit 951c789; new tests now pin them): the chain-menu pictures, which chain_icons draws in ON_BAR #171b3c for Active and Selected, and the pointer's glow, which in Kasandra is a VIOLET_PALE halo with 0 green pixels over BAR, BAR_EDGE and AMBER_SOFT. Fixed now: (a) six lists with a sheet of their own now use her highlight for a selected row through boss_theme.chosen_row: the process list, Log, Explore results, cabinet, Documents and the Slate switch (switched on, it also gets her edge). (b) In Kasandra the PDF evidence mark is the opaque edge alone. (c) The sheet's Run button takes the keyboard in her yellow. (d) Every old colour that boss_theme.LEGACY sent to yellow is listed and decided. (e) The logo is kept at 588x352 instead of the decoded 1401x838. (f) Her light around the writing line and the Field's selected sheet is now opaque warm tones (boss_theme.warm). (g) The logo's ghosts at Neon are quieter when settled. Left for the owner, unchanged: the menu row's 2 px edge colour. (2) Words. tools/name_sweep.py NEVER now also catches 'Programs' and a named key (KEYS). The sweep reads whatsThis and walks the Guide pages (in_guides). About 25 tips, notes and labels no longer name a key, and the Stop tip no longer says 'Programs'. Three key texts are kept in a reviewed KEYS_KEPT list and reported. (3) test_faces_find_light: the test was wrong, not the look. It measured HLS lightness, which overstates blue. It now measures luminance and asks it of every look's tone. (4) tools/colour_vision.py and tests_integrated/test_colour_vision.py simulate weak red and weak green sight (Machado 2009, severity 0.6 and 1.0) and measure CIEDE2000 with a threshold of 10. Under the threshold are 25 pairs in Graphite and 11 in Kasandra. Every one has a reviewed word-or-shape entry, and no palette colour was changed. (5) Frames were taken in both looks at both sizes. In Graphite, outside live areas, 0 pixels changed except the reworded Log note (1652 px). Tests touched or affected pass in both looks.

decisions: test_faces_find_light: the test was wrong, not the look. It measured 'how bright' as HLS lightness ((max+min)/2), which calls a blue brighter than it is. Kasandra's desk light #8f97c9 read 172 of 255 and failed, though it gives about a third of white's light (Graphite's warm tone gives about a quarter). It now measures relative luminance (<0.4) and also asks that a page stands clear of the desk (>4x the ground), for every palette.

Her light: the review asked for warm ring pixels. Yellow added as light (0.8.3's lays_light) or thinned over her indigo comes out grey, so her light is now one opaque warm tone per strength: boss_theme.warm(share), from LIGHT_FLOOR #261c0e to AMBER_EDGE. In the Field it is laid on the ground before the columns, wires and sheets (Kasandra only), so nothing cyan lies under it. Visible effect: where sheets overlap, the sheet above covers part of the selected sheet's outer rings. The writing line uses whole opaque rows of warm tone above and below the box, with antialiasing off. A lit word's bloom is a deep warm tone at 0.8, so the letters stay sharp. Graphite paints exactly as before.

Lists with their own sheet: one helper, boss_theme.chosen_row(fill, words), gives Kasandra's AMBER_SOFT/AMBER_TEXT and in Graphite returns the list's own values, so Graphite is unchanged by construction. The Slate switch, switched on, is her highlight whole (fill, words and edge).

LEGACY decisions (recorded in boss_theme.py next to LEGACY_DECIDED). Kept as her yellow: #d4b56a (the paper desk's pencil, the chosen line's mark) -> AMBER_EDGE; #f2a369 (Graphite's band pencil, the chosen band word) -> BAND_PENCIL. Changed: #f8edc9 (the paper desk's writing passage) -> CUE, because a place to write is not a highlight; #4b2a14, #ff9a36 and #ffba72 (Graphite's amber wash, edge and words, used for both a selection and a cue) -> CUE, CUE_EDGE, CUE_TEXT, her blue and cyan as until 0.8.3. A highlight is asked for by name. No sheet in the program writes those three by hand today.
The PDF evidence mark in Kasandra is the 2 px opaque edge alone: no fill at all, because any see-through yellow over a page's blue or cyan ink is green. Graphite keeps its 50/255 amber wash.

The sheet's Run button: hover stays her cyan (the pointer), and focus becomes AMBER_TEXT with an AMBER_EDGE border. In Graphite those tokens equal the old CUE_TEXT and CUE_EDGE values, so Graphite is unchanged.
The logo: kept at 8x the button height (588x352), smooth-scaled once. The file is let go after scaling. At button size it matches the full file to within 2/255 on average.

The logo's ghosts: settled, they stand 1 px away and are capped at 0.3. The catch keeps its full spread (3.9 px, which is 1.5 x 2.6) and surge (0.75), so the movement the owner sees on opening Apps is the same.

Fixed already, not touched: the chain_icons Active/Selected pixmaps in ON_BAR, and the pointer's VIOLET_PALE halo in Kasandra (both from commit 951c789, 0.8.3). Only tests were added. Their BEFORE failures came only from the shared probe calling the new chosen_row.
Left for the owner as instructed: the menu row's 2 px edge colour (BAR_EDGE). Not changed.

Key sweep: KEYS catches chords (Ctrl+, Shift+, Alt+, Meta, Super, Cmd), 'Ctrl X', F1-F12, Esc, 'press Enter/Tab/Space/X', 'Enter opens/runs/searches/filters...', 'or Enter' and 'arrow keys'. It skips verbs such as 'Enter one quote', 'Return to the files' and 'Close Tab'. It looks only in the program's own words (KEY_KINDS: text, tips, status tips, whatsThis, placeholder, accessible name and description, titles, tabs, headers). List rows and page text are the owner's data. 'Programs' is caught everywhere.

Reviewed key texts kept (KEYS_KEPT), reported as findings rather than deleted. (1) explore_qt F1_NOTE 'F1 reads the highlighted row into the typing-bar note.': an accessible description, on no tip; F1 is the only keyboard way to hear a row's note. (2) arc_desktop tree search accessible name '...press Enter to search everything': read to someone with no pointer. (3) 'Arrow keys move, Z selects, X returns, and Enter leaves a game.': a console game is played with keys.

This run changed one of the first run's KEYS_KEPT calls. The tree search's tip 'Enter searches components, nets, files, commands and jobs' had been kept as 'no word to click'. But the search icon button beside it does the same search with the typed text. The tip now names that button, and its KEYS_KEPT entry is gone.

Menu action texts that still carry a key after a tab (e.g. 'New Idea…\tCtrl+Shift+N', 'Run an operation…\tAlt+3') were left. tool_faces cuts everything after the tab and turns off the shortcut column before a menu shows it (workbench/tool_faces.py lines 260-261), so no key reaches the screen, and the walk in both looks finds none.

Guide pages: GETTING_STARTED.md and docs/WORKSHOP.md are the pages Guide opens in the program, so their words count as on screen. Step 4 now says 'Apps, at the upper right, opens the list of apps' instead of 'The cat ... programs list (Space or Enter on it too)'. 'Ctrl Z takes any change back' became 'Saying undo in the strip takes any change back', which matches document_qt.UNDO_WORDS. WORKSHOP.md no longer names Ctrl+Shift+P or Ctrl+P.

Colour vision: CIEDE2000, not CIE76, because CIE76 overstates differences between saturated colours, and these are saturated. The threshold is 10, the usual least for colours that name categories when seen apart. The Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes 2009 matrices are applied in linear sRGB at severity 0.6 and 1.0, and the docstring cites them. Every meaning's word or shape, and where it is drawn, is in SIGNS. REVIEWED holds the pairs a person checked. No palette colour was changed.

Graphite's palette gives one amber (#ff9a36) to five meanings: chosen, waits, fails, recheck and stopped. These are told apart only by words and shapes (an edge and filled ground; 'waits for you' and a dotted square; 'does not hold' and a cross; 'recheck' and a half-filled square; DELETE, Forget, 'stopped'). I recorded this as reviewed, not changed. The owner may want to know that Graphite leans entirely on signs there.
tools/check_hatch.py FOCUSED_MODULES: 'test_colour_vision' is added on its own line with its own 0.8.4 comment, right after 0.8.3's 'test_kasandra_highlight' line. Other builders' lines are separate.
not_done: The full suite was not run (as instructed; the coordinator runs it in both looks at merge). Modules run: the 21-module set of the first run in both looks (from its progress note; its per-module logs were lost in the cut-off), and this run test_one_name, test_context_menu and test_desk_acts in both looks on the final patch.

The first run's module set ran on the patch without this run's small fix (arc_desktop tree-search tip, one KEYS_KEPT entry, one line in test_one_name). test_one_name was re-run on the final patch in both looks. No other module asserts that tip (grep).
tools/check_head_ui.py: one assertion flipped (the kill tip must no longer contain Ctrl+Shift+F12). It was not run in this run, and I cannot confirm the first run ran it.

test_graphite line 168 checks that shell2.QuietWords.explain keeps keys in a note 'in print'. I did not look into whether any shown note uses explain() with a key. The walk in both looks finds none outside KEYS_KEPT.

Frames were not retaken after this run's tip fix: the tip is not visible in any of the four frames. The Kasandra frames were looked at by eye this run (menu 1920, line and Field crops before and after, Log 1366). The Graphite frames were judged by the pixel comparison only.
test_faces_find_light's failure on the unchanged tree in Kasandra is taken from the task statement. I did not re-run the unchanged module this run.
Nothing ran on the owner's ThinkPad; everything ran offscreen in throwaway copies here.
release_note: In the Kasandra look, her burnt-yellow light round the writing line and the Field's chosen sheet is now a warm glow instead of grey. A selected row in the Log, the process list, Explore, the cabinet and Documents now shows her highlight. The PDF evidence mark is a clean yellow edge, and the kp logo's neon ghosts no longer double its thin strokes. Tips, notes and the Getting Started guide no longer name keyboard keys or say "Programs", and a test now catches any that come back. A new colour-vision check simulates weak red and weak green sight on both looks' colours and makes sure that every pair of meanings those eyes cannot tell apart also has a word or a shape that does.
